description: c/n 683D-6691; built by FIAT and first flown July 1965 as KC+164; delivered to the West German Navy November 1965 as VB+225 and later 21+30; served only with MFG-2 at Eggebek; retired January 1985; transferred to the Hellenic Air Force April 1985 as 6691 code RF-691; retired April 1992 and pole-mounted; last noted September 2024
aliases: RF104G; RF104; Starfighter; RF-691; 21+30; VB+225; RF691
